notes:
Account snapshot: Ironclad Archives Ltd — national-scale archival customer managing sensitive historical records and legal deposit materials. MUST be on-prem / air-gapped; absolutely no outbound model download by default.

Recent timeline:
- 2026-01-20: Intro call (AE + SE) — customer wants private control plane, strict data residency (UK/EU), asked about offline model install process.
- 2026-02-05: Security deep-dive with InfoSec (Fireflies FF-20260218-IA-01). Discussed KMS/HSM options; they require PKCS#11-compatible HSM and FIPS 140-2 validated crypto.
- 2026-02-18: On-site network review request; they provided network diagram and proxy rules.
- 2026-02-25: POC kickoff call (FF-20260225-IA-02). Agreed to 4-week lab POC: on-prem air-gapped deployment in their staging datacenter.
- 2026-03-02: SE delivered preliminary install checklist; customer wants explicit offline model signing & checksum verification steps.

Technical / requirements summary:
- Workloads: high-volume document search, ad-hoc legal discovery, automated redaction pipeline, long-form summarization for legal briefs.
- Latency/throughput: 50 RPS search endpoints (95th p95 < 300ms for short queries), batch redaction runs overnight on 8x A100-equivalent nodes.
- Models: prefer open models (LLM v2 family), quantized variants acceptable if reproduction of redaction accuracy validated.
- Routing/fallback: primary on-prem models; fallback to dedicated hosted only if explicitly allowed via bilateral agreement (currently blocked).
- Data residency: all plaintext and derived embeddings must remain on-prem; metadata and audit logs retained for 10 years per retention policy.
- KMS/HSM: customer-managed HSM (YubiHSM / Thales) used for key material; integration via PKCS#11 or KMIP. No Redwood-managed keys.
- Audit/logging: immutable audit trail, tamper-evident logs, exportable to their SIEM (Splunk). Require log signing and signing-key rotation policy.
- Security: SSO via SAML, SCIM for user provisioning, SOC2/ISO27001 evidence required for vendor security attestation.
- Network: strictly outbound-blocked environment; management plane may be air-gapped with physical USB transfer of manifests.

POC scope and acceptance criteria:
- Deliver an air-gapped installation playbook and automatable installer (Ansible/Tarball) that runs in their closed staging environment.
- Demonstrate model loading offline and integrity verification; show inference accuracy parity on redaction testset.
- Integrate with customer HSM for key wrapping of model artifacts and TLS keys.
- Provide audit logs exported to their Splunk instance; retention & rotation tested.

Quotes / customer voice:
- "We cannot have any external egress during normal operation — even for telemetry." — Head of InfoSec
- "Need proof of deterministic redaction parity before we allow production rollout." — Dir. of Legal Tech

Next steps (short):
- SE to deliver detailed HSM/KMS integration spec (due 2026-03-15).
- Schedule 2-week on-site POC window (customer prefers 2026-04).
- Legal to circulate DPA + addendum for air-gapped operations.

Blockers (current):
- Missing formal air-gapped deployment runbook/installer.
- HSM spec still pending from customer side (affects timeline).
- Internal procurement sign-off pending — budget holder change introduced delay.

Related artifacts: pricing deck + security answers linked in Drive (see linked_drive_docs). Jira INF-8931 open for air-gapped installer request.
